inScope: provider-side durable acknowledgement state (JSON-lines ledgers under a private state directory)
release evidence determinism and signature custody
plugin-host inherited descriptor containment at the exec boundary
checkpoint v2 canonical evidence and the v16 -> v17 store migration
outOfScopeForRC3: VM-grade hostile-code isolation (restricted process mode is not a hostile-code sandbox)
new provider matrix entries, model backends, RSI promotion
a second authority kernel or orchestration framework
threatModelScope.adversary: a corrupted or unreadable durable ledger, a torn write at any commit boundary, an out-of-band edit of provider state, a racing Stop, an inherited descriptor above the legacy sweep bound, a stale or mutable release attestation, and a rolled-back database plus local checkpoint pair — each must fail closed at an observable boundary
